numeric_acceptance.fill_ID: Keep decimal IDs as strings from raw wire before lossy Number parsing; reject rounded/ambiguous IDs. No timestamp-as-ID fabrication.

numeric_acceptance.zero: Zero is factual only when the complete relevant source response/counter proves it. Missing data stays unknown.
numeric_acceptance.rounding_tolerance: Not selected before actual decimal/tick/size evidence; no arbitrary new percentage tolerance.
